snippet.title: While 1 - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/5165360/While_1_Demo/

This demo contains a small portion of the content that will be available in the full game: 24 Normal levels, 8 Expert levels, and 9 unlockable color palettes.
